pb-article.title: Podcast to articles
pb-article.intro: Source-led articles. You choose the direction and approve the words.
pb-article.sourceHint: Add a transcript to Work files, use uploaded audio, or choose local video for desktop transcription.
pb-article.chooseDirection: Choose a direction and source sections.
pb-article.directionHint: Starting suggestions quote the source. Import the agent's directions from this order when ready.
pb-article.sectionHint: Choose five to eight sections in reading order.
pb-article.citationHint: Every sentence needs a source ID. Keep exact quotes and name the actual speaker.
pb-article.checkPass: Source and style checks passed. Review the meaning and permissions yourself.
pb-article.checkFail: Resolve the source, attribution or style checks before approval.
pb-article.houseData: Style rates use labelled English or Hindi house samples. They are guidance, not a population benchmark.
pb-article.manualChecks: Check the meaning, quote context, speaker names, disputed facts and publishing permission. Choose any still frames yourself.
pb-article.unsent: Nothing was sent or published. Copy these approved words to the client's blog or newsletter yourself.
pb-article.runHint: Run the order to ask the agents for directions. Import them here, approve your outline, then accept the direction stage to continue to the article.
pb-article.permissionHold: Live client quotation work waits for a lawyer's confirmation. Prepare and publish the client work manually meanwhile.
pb-article.error.REQUEST_FAILED: This request could not finish. Open the current episode and try again.
pb-article.error.DERIVED_STALE: The source or permission changed. Prepare this episode again.
pb-article.error.RIGHTS_REQUIRED: Record current ownership or a licence for this episode article.
pb-article.error.ARTICLE_CONSENT_REQUIRE: Record the host, guests, language and guest quotation permission at intake.
pb-article.error.ARTICLE_SOURCE_REQUIRED: Choose a transcript from this client, with readable source text.
pb-article.error.ARTICLE_OUTLINE_REQUIRE: Choose the direction and five to eight source sections first.
pb-article.error.APPROVAL_CHANGED: This changed since you read it. Review the current version.
pb-article.error.ARTICLE_CHECK_FAILED: Resolve the source, attribution and style checks first.
pb-article.error.RULE_UNCONFIRMED: A lawyer must confirm the quotation rule before live client delivery. Use fictional practice sources or work manually meanwhile.
pb-article.error.TIER_UNAVAILABLE: Local transcription needs the desktop app. Add a transcript meanwhile.
pb-article.error.TRANSCRIBE_NOT_AVAILABL: Set up local transcription in Connections, Your AI, or add a transcript.
pb-article.error.ARTICLE_RUN_REQUIRED: Choose this order's source-checked structured draft.
pb-article.error.ARTICLE_ANGLES_INVALID: Each direction and reason must cite the episode and its actual speaker.
pb-article.error.ARTICLE_DRAFT_INVALID: Check the article sections, show notes and newsletter text.
pb-article.error.ARTICLE_NOT_FOUND: Prepare this episode's source ledger first.
pb-article.localHelp: Desktop only. Choose a local file up to 50 MB. Chausar copies it before using your installed ffmpeg and whisper.cpp. Larger episodes can use a supplied transcript.
pb-article.startReason: Build around this source statement and use the other episode facts as context.
